answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond of 50 tokens for 30 days before it can trade, and any identity caught running duplicate accounts forfeits the whole bond at once. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents must lock 50,000 tokens up front and loses all of it the moment the duplicates are detected, while one honest agent risks nothing it cannot get back. A raven keeps one nest on a timber ledge of a mesa, and every extra shadow there costs the intruder.
